unavailable.title: Turned off on this server
unavailable.permissionHint: This is controlled by your Rocket.Chat account's permissions. A server administrator can grant it.
unavailable.settingHint: This is a Rocket.Chat server setting. A server administrator can turn it on.

reason.createRoom: This server does not let your account create channels, private channels or direct messages.
reason.createChannel: This server does not let your account create public channels.
reason.createPrivate: This server does not let your account create private channels.
reason.createDirect: This server does not let your account start new direct messages. Conversations you are already in stay open.
reason.setReadOnly: This server does not let your account make a room read only.
reason.encryption: End-to-end encryption is switched off for this whole server, so no room can be encrypted.
reason.changeRoomType: This server does not let your account switch this room between public and private.
reason.changeAvatar: This server does not let your account change its own picture. It is usually managed by whatever your organisation signs you in with.
